objective: Turn a missing or stale reference description from a confusing preflight failure into a visible, single-flight, recoverable step that automatically rechecks every gate and then continues candidate-only inference.

behavior.automatic_continuation: After a successful description request, /api/run/readiness is fetched again. Inference is submitted only when the refreshed workflow gate is ready.
behavior.single_flight: Concurrent requests for the same file, topic and reference frame share one promise; a different reference request is rejected while the first is active.
behavior.status_consistency: The compact state summary now distinguishes description_stale from description_missing using the same active reference contract as the run readiness endpoint.

auto_repair_requires: workflow failure limited to description_missing or description_stale
integer reference_frame returned by the server
safety_contract.backend_binding: The existing /api/describe endpoint rechecks file, topic, configuration, labels, selected labels, reference frames, reference truth and reference signature before atomically saving a derived description.
safety_contract.candidate_boundary: Inference output remains candidate_only and cannot become human truth or training approval without the existing explicit human gate.

python_utf8.command_scope: tests/ via unittest discovery with PYTHONUTF8=1

targeted_cases: stale description regenerates once and readiness is rechecked
description generation failure remains not started
non-description workflow failure never calls describe
compact summary reports stale and ready consistently
readiness dialog exposes the fifth description gate
regression.environment_note: An initial full Python run without PYTHONUTF8 reproduced the known Windows GBK decoding failures in unrelated UTF-8 fixtures. The canonical project environment reran the same 862 tests cleanly; no test or fixture was weakened.

isolated_browser_acceptance.timing_boundary: The description request reused an exact model response cache. The 1.284 second duration is not a cold VLM latency claim; the hard evidence is the visible recovery state, one describe request, one run request, successful recheck, candidate visibility and unchanged truth.

deployment.lifecycle: Only the managed local workbench was restarted. The verified 4090 tunnel and remote SAM/VLM processes remained hot; the optional 5090 route remained unavailable and the primary route was used.
